title: Japanese Lentil Casserole
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with traditional lentil casserole ingredients. Serve as a side dish or light meal.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the ginger and green onions in sesame oil until fragrant.
Add the lentils, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a separate pan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter and toast the bread cubes until crispy.
In a large casserole dish, combine the cooked lentil mixture and toasted bread. Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
